label: L=3 copy phase (outputting 2nd/3rd token)
explanation: Fires almost exclusively in the copy phase of length-3 sequences, at steps t=4 and t=5 (outputting original tokens 1 and 2); 99.4% of activation mass lies there. Stronger at t=4 (right after <DEL>, ~80% of such steps active, 71% of mass) than at t=5 (~47% active). Top activations are t=4 steps with the first token o/2/h. Never fires in the original phase, on the delimiter step, at recall_idx 0, or for L>=5; a small tail (0.6% of mass) at t=5-7 of L=4 sequences. Only ~63% of L=3 copy steps are active, and no simple token condition (digit count, out_count, letter vs digit) explains which ones, so precision is incomplete.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the current input token, by step (t=5: o, 2, h, u; t=6: o, 2, p, u; t=7: o, 2, p) and the third original token (most: c, d, a, q, y, b; least: g, 2, u, i); timing cues that raise it most: L=3, L=3 & t=4, L=3 & t=5.
